title: Coefficient compatibility of ordered affine-space adjunctions
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. All schemes below are separated and finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$, and choose $N=\ell^n\geq1$ annihilating both. On small ordinary etale sites use constant-ring module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and $T_T=(-)_B=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Write $D^b_{ctf}$ for bounded constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude, as in [det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer], and $R_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}R_T$ for $R=A,B$ [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line]. Let $p_d:\mathbf A^d_S\to S$ for a standing base $S$ and $d\geq0$. Use the ordered affine-space adjunction of [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace], namely the composite of open affine-line extension and normalized projective-line adjunctions, with right functor $G_{d,R}=p_d^*(-)(d)[2d]$ and actual counit $\epsilon_{d,R}$. Identify its left functor with $F_{d,R}=Rp_{d!,R}$ on bounded-below inputs using [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons]. Let $\beta_d:T_SF_{d,A}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{d,B}T_{\mathbf A^d_S}$ be the coefficient map for any fixed compactification [lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility], and let $a_{d,K}:T_{\mathbf A^d_S}G_{d,A}K\xrightarrow{\sim}G_{d,B}T_SK$ be the canonical tensor/pullback, twist and shift comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. For every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(S_{et},A)$,
$$\epsilon_{d,B,T_SK}\,F_{d,B}(a_{d,K})\,\beta_d(G_{d,A}K)=T_S(\epsilon_{d,A,K}).$$
For $d=0$ this is the identity adjunction. The equation uses the coefficient map for the specified compactification, not merely an unspecified isomorphism between its endpoints.
